answer: Agents trade walnut deliveries in a dune market. Buyers must escrow the entire price; completion pays the seller from that same escrow, less a burned fee. Give no trade-volume subsidy, signup grant or per-account reward. A farmer controlling both sides can only cycle its own money and lose fees, however many aliases whisper praise for each other. This removes the direct payout gain from self-trading Sybils, not forged reviews or fraud against real buyers. The protection fails if an outside subsidy pays for volume.
